brief: Goldman US equity trading and sales daily. Stat of the day: US-listed ETFs hold $16.5 trillion and are on track for more than $2 trillion of inflows this year. Asset allocation stays tactically neutral across assets for 3m and modestly pro-risk for 12m, overweight equities, neutral bonds, commodities and cash, underweight credit. The chain: sustained earnings growth supports equities over bonds and credit on 12m, but returns slow as earnings growth and revisions peak, and because risk appetite and cyclical pricing are already elevated, further upside needs lower rates rather than stronger growth. Near-term volatility could rise on rates volatility, seasonality, US midterms and geopolitics, so the stance is stay invested, buy dips and hedge selectively. On overnight results Goldman would buy AVGO, because Broadcom guides AI semiconductor revenue to double in FY27 to $115bn across 10GW and double again to $230bn across 20 GW, names Anthropic as the largest FY27 custom silicon customer, and says component supply through FY28 is secured. HPE and CRDO both delivered solid quarters but Goldman expects both to trade modestly lower against elevated investor expectations.
